breadcrumb: Std 6 Science Term-III (English) — Unit 3: Chemistry in Everyday Life — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Chemists identify turmeric powder as a 'natural indicator'. The change in colour indicates that the material is either acid or base medium.

en.q: Turmeric powder is identified by chemists as a ______.
en.explanation: A colour change in turmeric shows whether a material is acidic or basic.

ta.explanation: மஞ்சள் தூளின் நிற மாற்றம் அமிலம் அல்லது காரம் என்பதைக் காட்டும். (மேலும்: இயற்கை நிறங்காட்டி.)

questions.quote: The idly batter undergoes a chemical change by bacteria named fermentation. We could prepare soft idly as a result.

en.q: Idly batter becomes soft because of a chemical change called ______.
en.explanation: The idly batter undergoes this chemical change by bacteria.

ta.q: இட்லி மாவு மென்மையாவது ______ என்ற வேதியியல் மாற்றத்தால்.

questions.quote: The water (H2O) we drink is the combination of hydrogen and oxygen. The salt (NaCl) we use in our kitchen is a combination of the chemicals, sodium and chlorine.

en.q: Common salt (NaCl) is a combination of ______.
en.explanation: Water (H₂O) is a combination of hydrogen and oxygen.

questions.quote: Nitrogen (N), Phosphorous (P) and Potassium (K) are the three important nutrients needed for the growth of plants. These three are called as Principal Nutrients.

en.q: In the symbol NPK, K stands for ______.
en.explanation: N stands for nitrogen and P for phosphorus.

questions.quote: Fertilizers containing only plant or animal-based materials are called organic fertilizers (e.g. Vermi compost, compost). Inorganic fertilizers are prepared in factories (e.g. Urea, Ammonium sulphate, Super phosphate and Potassium nitrate).

en.explanation: Inorganic fertilizers are made in factories by chemical changes.

ta.explanation: கனிம உரங்கள் தொழிற்சாலைகளில் வேதி மாற்றத்தால் தயாரிக்கப்படுகின்றன.

questions.quote: If we use 50 kg of urea, then according to the table, 23 kg of nitrogen (46 percent) will be added to the soil.

en.explanation: 50 kg of urea adds 23 kg of nitrogen to the soil.

ta.explanation: 50 கிகி யூரியா 23 கிகி நைட்ரஜனை மண்ணுக்குத் தரும்.

questions.quote: In 1824, Joseph Aspdin invented Portland cement by burning finely ground chalk and clay in a kiln. It was named Portland cement because it resembled the high-quality building stones found in Portland, England.

en.q: Portland cement was invented in 1824 by ______.
en.explanation: It was named after the building stones found in Portland, England.

ta.explanation: இங்கிலாந்தின் போர்ட்லாந்து கட்டுமானக் கற்களை ஒத்திருந்ததால் இப்பெயர் வந்தது.

questions.quote: Gypsum is a soft white or grey, naturally available mineral. The chemical name of gypsum is calcium sulphate dihydrate.

en.q: The chemical name of gypsum is ______.

questions.quote: Epsom salt is magnesium sulphate hepta hydrate. The molecular formula of Epsom is MgSO4 . 7H2O.

en.q: The molecular formula of Epsom salt is ______.
en.explanation: Epsom salt is magnesium sulphate heptahydrate.

questions.quote: Phenol is a carbolic acid. Phenol used as surgical antiseptic since it kills micro organisms. Diluted phenol is used as a cleaner, disinfectant and mouthwash.

en.q: Phenol is used as a surgical antiseptic because it ______.
en.explanation: Phenol kills micro-organisms, so it is used as an antiseptic.

ta.q: பீனால் அறுவை சிகிச்சைக் கிருமிநாசினியாகப் பயன்படுவது, அது ______.

questions.quote: The substances applied to one surface, or both the surfaces of two separate items that binds them together and resists their separation are called adhesives. It is commonly known as glue, mucilage, or paste.

en.q: Substances like glue, mucilage and paste that bind two surfaces together are called ______.
en.explanation: Cello tape has a paste-like adhesive on one surface.

ta.q: இரு பரப்புகளை இணைக்கும் பசை, கோந்து போன்ற பொருள்கள் ______ எனப்படும்.
ta.explanation: செல்லோ டேப்பின் ஒரு பக்கத்தில் பசை போன்ற பொருள் உள்ளது. (மேலும்: பசைகள்.)

questions.quote: Earthworms take organic wastes as food and produce compost castings. So earthworms are known as Farmer's friends because of the multitude of services they provide to improve soil health.

en.q: Earthworms are called farmer's friends because they ______.
options: eat all the crops in fields
en.explanation: Vermi compost has high nutrient benefits.

questions.quote: Gypsum plays a very important role in controlling the rate of hardening of the cement. Gypsum is added to control the 'setting of cement'.

en.q: During cement manufacture, gypsum is added at the ______ grinding process.
en.explanation: A small amount of gypsum is added to control the setting of cement.

ta.q: சிமெண்ட் தயாரிப்பில் ஜிப்சம் ______ அரைக்கும் நிலையில் சேர்க்கப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: சிமெண்ட் இறுகுவதைக் கட்டுப்படுத்த சிறிதளவு ஜிப்சம் சேர்க்கப்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: There are two kinds of adhesives, one is natural made from starch and another one is artificial made from chemicals. The one used in puncture shop is an artificial adhesive.

en.q: The adhesive used in a puncture repair shop is a(n) ______ adhesive.
en.explanation: Natural adhesives are made from starch.
